feeds.title: Discover Starbucks Reserve
feeds.description: This blog is a place for pure coffee education. It's for those who love a great cup of coffee and the fun cards that come with Starbucks Reserve coffees.

feeds.title: StarbucksMelody
feeds.description: StarbucksMelody website is the best source of unofficial Starbucks news and information about Starbucks and their brands: Teavana, Seattle's Best Coffee, Evolution Fresh, La Boulange, and Tazo Tea. It is a place for a community of Starbucks enthusiasts in a positive, informative and uplifting setting.
